name: beam
title: Body cross beam
orientation: Flat on one side, its screw holes along the bed: each hole a teardrop
description: A beam across the body between the side plates: it holds them square against the legs' push. Three of them, screwed in through the plates.

long.rule: Between the two side plates' inner faces

deep.rule: Across the body's length: its two screws at each end, plus room, and clear of the hip motors

wide.rule: Thick: 25 layers of stiffness for the side plates to pull on

pilot.rule: An M3 self-tapped into each end

pilot_len.rule: For an M3 × 16 through a side plate

screw_y.rule: The two screws at each end
